comment: Blessed from the pinned engine, hand-checked to the dollar. THE NULL CASE, locked deliberately beside the pair: the same 12,000 self-rental profit with no other passive loss on the return. Recharacterization happens (the engine's own per-property recharacterized net is 12,000 against 0 with the lessee answer No) and moves NO served line, because there is no passive loss for the profit to have sheltered - the income only changes which Schedule E channel carries it. Line 9 is 48,250 + 12,000 = 60,250; taxable 44,500; tax 5,105 = table(44,525 midpoint) = 1,192.50 + 12% of 32,600 = 5,104.50; overpaid 895 - digit for digit what a 12,000 commercial rental serves. A fixture on this case ALONE would prove nothing about the rule, which is why the pair exists; this one exists so the rule is pinned as not moving what it must not move.
